title: One command creates a working site folder
description:
Starting a site is about twelve manual steps copied from another repository.

```gherkin
Feature: Site scaffold

  Scenario: A new site folder builds
    Given an empty folder
    When I run the site scaffold with a site name
    Then the folder holds the settings, deployment files and tests for that site
    And its tests pass
    And no AWS identifier is written to any file

  Scenario: A site inside a monorepo
    Given a repository that already holds a deployment
    When I run the scaffold for a second site
    Then only that site's folder and the site list change
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: First test case for the scaffold: the Humorus site layout (branch site/skeleton, PR to follow). Hand-written or copied, in order of how much a scaffold should generate: boilerplate copied verbatim (next.config.mjs, tsconfig.json, papyrus-modules.d.ts, postcss.config.mjs, amplify/backend.ts, amplify/data/resource.ts); templated from a few inputs (package.json with exact pins from Papyrus's own peerDependencies, requirements-publication.txt, papyrus.config.ts, publication/brand.ts and theme.css, .gitignore additions, infra/site.json including the now-mandatory email block). Gaps: no papyrus-app init; papyrus-infra has no validate-only mode and needs PAPYRUS_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID even to synth; typecheck needs a stub amplify_outputs.json; examples/pretext.site.json is stale (no email, old papyrusVersion); github.ownerId and repoId are undocumented. Pretext needs no site code (markus-static needs hook code, against rule 2).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scaffold gap found 2026-11-12: a new site's infra/site.json must set the four PAPYRUS_ENABLE_* flags (console responder, Slack, inbound email, storage backups) explicitly; the console responder defaults to ON and needs a container image, so the first Amplify build failed publishing it (docs/site-hosting.md, Backend features). The scaffold must write them (false by default) and papyrus-infra synth should warn when they are missing.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scaffold note, 2026-11-13: the console's Connect repository wizard wipes the branch's environment variables and turns auto-build ON, and starts a build with no variables (job 1, stopped; job 2 was an auto-build for the next push). CloudFormation cannot see the drift; the variables were re-applied by a stack input change and auto-build set false. Also on PPY-f30ad5 in Papyrus.
